queue_occupancy_and_wait_time_telemetry_.instantaneous_queue_depth: UNMEASURED_STATICALLY (Retrospective GitHub REST/run lists do not record continuous queue occupancy over time; workflow creation timestamps cannot be used to infer queue concurrency).
queue_occupancy_and_wait_time_telemetry_.enqueue_to_merge_wait_time: UNMEASURED_STATICALLY (GitHub does not expose enqueue timestamp in pr/run list API).
queue_occupancy_and_wait_time_telemetry_.assigned_collection_stage: WP-35B/C implementation and live observation window must collect continuous queue occupancy and enqueue-to-merge latency via active GraphQL polling or webhook telemetry.
queue_occupancy_and_wait_time_telemetry_.measurement_conclusion: Retrospective data establishes that CI takes ~20.6 min (median) and merges occur on average every ~50–55 min (median gap) in the creation-ordered sample. Instantaneous queue depth and waiting times remain unmeasured statically and are assigned to WP-35B/C.
